uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2023-3755-4770-5434.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4518-5223.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-1021-5226-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1957-4050-5332--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1978-3099-5793-7434.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding two mana.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
1978-3099-5793-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2178-5686-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-5686-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-5686-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

2691-3457-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
2691-3457-7791.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Ilysian Caryatid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.

1368-4289-4359-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-4359-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4657-5295-6083-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two basic lands.
4657-5295-6083-6871.description:
Activate two basic lands by tapping them, adding {6} due to Virtue of Strength.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two basic lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
4657-5295-6083-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 2 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-4742-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1558-1671-3875-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-3875-4231-4772.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1017-3532-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4050-4533-4807-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
4050-4533-4807-6441.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3470-5702-6871.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control a land that enters untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
3470-5702-6871.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, animating a land you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
During your next turn, cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to an animated land.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
Repeat from step 4.

104-1818-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1818-3197.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-997-3497-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

710-997-1052.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

81-1247-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
81-1247-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2617-4031-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
2617-4031-4613-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Electromancer that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Ardent Electromancer token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Electromancer token's trigger, adding at least {R}.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
2617-4031-4613-5917.notes: If you control at least one Cleric, Rogue or Warrior, this combo nets infinite red mana. Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using step 1 instead.

1812-3430-3525-3793.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
1812-3430-3525-3793.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding nine {C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

914-1170-2556-3130-4074.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
914-1170-2556-3130-4074.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
The Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Mnemonic Wall and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

1987-2556-3830.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and the Island.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2144-4215-5311.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Riftsweeper, adding {C}{C}.
Riftsweeper dies, triggering Verdant Succession and Myrkul.
Resolve the Myrkul trigger, causing you to exile Riftsweeper and create a token copy of Riftsweeper that is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
The Riftsweeper token enters the battlefield, shuffling the nontoken Riftsweeper into your library from exile.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger from step 2, searching your library for Riftsweeper and putting it onto the battlefield.
Riftsweeper enters the battlefield, shuffling any exiled card into its owner's library.
Repeat.

1284-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Viridian Longbow attached to Malcolm.
Malcolm does not have summoning sickness.
1284-4222-4508.description:
Activate Malcolm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Malcolm.
Repeat.

1309-1518-1987-3941.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1309-1518-1987-3941.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

2497-4377-5261.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Reclaim without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Reclaim, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
